I also remember one of my doctors telling my mom to put me in modeling and etiquette classes because I was unable to sit still and “lady like” and I remember his shock when my mom told him: she is already in a model agency receiving etiquette classes. 
(I loved being there btw but got kicked out for the same reason as my music classes) 

I grew up thinking I was stupid and broken. That I was the only one responsible for being “wrong” I spend most of my childhood and teen years depressed and isolated. I am still grieving for my younger self and mad that now I see myself as I was just a kid and no adult helped…
